name: High Resolution Spectrometer (HRS) at PEP
notes: HRS here is the High Resolution Spectrometer at SLAC PEP; it is unrelated to the LAMPF and Jefferson Lab spectrometers of the same name.
No HRS website exists; none is recorded. The last-data date is unresolved (see the interval notes).

physics_goals.locator: Argonne report ANL-HEP-CP-83-50 (J. M. Weiss), abstract
physics_goals.quote: The results of analyses are presented in the following areas: (1) QED and electroweak tests, (2) scalar electron search, (3) inclusive hadron production, (4) D/sup 0/, D/sup +/ and D* production, and studies of quark fragmentation.
physics_goals.value: Test QED and the electroweak theory, search for scalar electrons and study hadron and charm production

summary.plain: A general-purpose detector at SLAC's PEP electron-positron ring that took data from the end of 1981. It tested quantum electrodynamics and the electroweak theory, searched for scalar electrons and studied hadron production. Its end date is not documented in the sources found.
summary.technical: HRS at PEP: general-purpose solenoidal spectrometer, 29 GeV e⁺e⁻; collecting data since the end of 1981, 120 pb⁻¹ by 1983 and 291 pb⁻¹ in the 1990 four-lepton QED test (Phys. Rev. D 42, 2180). End of data taking not found (bracketed 1983 to 1990).
